tools.name: skill_audit
tools.description: Read-only installed-vs-used audit of the GJC skill catalog: per-skill used_count, last_used and install source from retained session transcripts, plus unused, duplicate and stale candidates with their basis. Skill tool calls and /skill: invocations count as use; catalog exposure and skill_discovery do not. Missing transcript coverage reports unknown, never zero uses, and a corrupt line degrades the report instead of hiding it. It does not prove skill quality or effect, never installs or deletes skills, changes no configuration and writes nothing.
